<h1 id="FAO-56-Penman-Monteith-Reference-Evapotranspiration-(ET%E2%82%80)">FAO-56 Penman-Monteith Reference Evapotranspiration (ET₀)<a class="anchor-link" href="#FAO-56-Penman-Monteith-Reference-Evapotranspiration-(ET%E2%82%80)">¶</a></h1><p><strong>Citation:</strong> Allen, R.G., Pereira, L.S., Raes, D., Smith, M. (1998). <em>FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56.</em> <a href="https://www.fao.org/4/X0490E/x0490e00.htm">https://www.fao.org/4/X0490E/x0490e00.htm</a></p>
<p><strong>Abstract.</strong> This notebook reproduces the FAO-56 Penman–Monteith reference evapotranspiration (ET₀) core algebra: saturation vapour pressure, the slope of the saturation curve, and the combined radiation–aerodynamic ET₀ equation. Worked examples (Bangkok, Uccle, Lyon) and tabulated vapour-pressure checks are validated against digitized FAO-56 benchmarks in the airSpring control suite.</p>
<p><strong>For other springs:</strong> Primal capability <code>science.et0_fao56</code>; Rust binary <code>validate_et0</code>. Results here should match <code>control/fao56/penman_monteith.py</code> when the same benchmark JSON is used.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="Theory">Theory<a class="anchor-link" href="#Theory">¶</a></h2><p>FAO-56 Eq. 6 (mm day⁻¹):</p>
<p>$$\mathrm{ET}_0 = \frac{0.408\,\Delta(R_n - G) + \gamma\,\frac{900}{T+273}\,u_2\,(e_s - e_a)}{\Delta + \gamma(1 + 0.34\,u_2)}$$</p>
<p>Saturation vapour pressure (Eq. 11):</p>
<p>$$e^\circ(T) = 0.6108\,\exp\left(\frac{17.27\,T}{T + 237.3}\right)$$</p>
<p>Slope of the curve (Eq. 13):</p>
<p>$$\Delta = \frac{4098\,e^\circ(T)}{(T + 237.3)^2}$$</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
